description: Figure 10 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The vertical y-axis, labeled “effect,” ranges from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal x-axis lists nine language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. For each language family, six colored bars represent the performance of different multilingual BERT models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red), as indicated by the legend in the top-right corner. Each bar is accompanied by vertical error bars, which denote the standard deviation of the measured effect. The height of the bars varies across language families and models, with the highest effects observed for the IE-Indic and Semitic families, particularly for the XLM-R₂ and XLM-B₂ models, while the Isolate and Uralic families show consistently low effects across all models. The bars within each group are arranged in a fixed order corresponding to the legend, and the chart visually emphasizes the variability in model performance depending on both the language family and the specific model architecture.
